name: family-english-learning
description: 面向家庭陪伴教学的英语学习网站

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @family-english/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @family-english/domain --filter @family-english/design-system --if-present build && corepack pnpm --filter @family-english/api --filter @family-english/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @family-english/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
